proofs.proof_tex:
Fix a row \(n\), a schedule admissible for the direction under consideration, and \(d\in\{\mathrm{PN},\mathrm{PS}\}\). We split on \(d\).

If \(d=\mathrm{PN}\), then \(b(d)=0\), \(t_d=\Theta_{\mathrm{PN}}(P_n)\), and the matching fitted-minus-oracle held-out score difference is \(\Delta_d=\Delta_{\mathrm{PN}}\). By \texttt{lem:pn-variance-consistency}, uniformly over \(P_n\in\mathcal M_{G,n}^{\mathrm{PN}}(r_n;c_G,C_G)\),
\[\mathbb P_n\Delta_d^2=O_{P_n^{\otimes n}}\!\left(a_{0,n}^2+r_na_{e,n}^2\right)=o_{P_n^{\otimes n}}(r_n),\qquad \frac{\widehat\sigma_{\mathrm{PN},n}^2(t_d)}{V_{\mathrm{PN}}(P_n)}\longrightarrow_{P_n^{\otimes n}}1,\]
and \(B_\varepsilon/\sqrt{nr_n}\to0\). Since \(a_{0,n}=a_{b(d),n}\), \(\widehat\sigma_{\mathrm{PN},n}^2=\widehat\sigma_{d,n}^2\), and \(V_{\mathrm{PN}}=V_d\) in this case, these are exactly the asserted conclusions.

If \(d=\mathrm{PS}\), then \(b(d)=1\), \(t_d=\Theta_{\mathrm{PS}}(P_n)\), and \(\Delta_d=\Delta_{\mathrm{PS}}\). By \texttt{lem:ps-variance-consistency}, uniformly over \(P_n\in\mathcal M_{G,n}^{\mathrm{PS}}(r_n;c_G,C_G)\),
\[\mathbb P_n\Delta_d^2=O_{P_n^{\otimes n}}\!\left(a_{1,n}^2+r_na_{e,n}^2\right)=o_{P_n^{\otimes n}}(r_n),\qquad \frac{\widehat\sigma_{\mathrm{PS},n}^2(t_d)}{V_{\mathrm{PS}}(P_n)}\longrightarrow_{P_n^{\otimes n}}1,\]
and again \(B_\varepsilon/\sqrt{nr_n}\to0\). Because \(a_{1,n}=a_{b(d),n}\), \(\widehat\sigma_{\mathrm{PS},n}^2=\widehat\sigma_{d,n}^2\), and \(V_{\mathrm{PS}}=V_d\) in this case, these too are precisely the asserted conclusions. The two cases exhaust the direction set.

Finally, by \texttt{def:score-inversion}, the empirical score and variance are computed before the preliminary acceptance set is formed. Replacing an empty preliminary set by the singleton \(\{0\}\) therefore changes neither \(\Delta_d\) nor \(\widehat\sigma_{d,n}^2(t_d)\), so the closed-set inversion and fallback do not affect any conclusion above.
